title: Pastiera Flux
highlights: Exact typing: in the apps you pick (SSH, code, AI agents) nothing rewrites what you type.
Pick suggestions from the keyboard with Ctrl+Shift+Q, W or E.
A dedicated emoji picker key, emoji layer profiles that follow the app, and GIF and symbol search.
App shortcuts in every app, Enter per app, terminal mode and hidden-keyboard apps.
A status bar fitted to the Titan 2 Elite, per-LED colours and a customisable menu bar.
Recommended settings apply a configuration made on a Titan 2 Elite.
improvements: Spell checker, emoji suggestions and inline autofill in the suggestion bar.
Paste suggestion for what you just copied, with tracking cleaned from pasted links.
Snippets fill in the date, time and clipboard.
Backspace undoes an auto-replace and keeps the space.
Voice input keeps listening through pauses.
Smart Alt and Ctrl, incognito typing and an offline mode.
Ctrl+Shift+Space switches language backwards; bold suggestions option.
Settings grouped by task and searchable; settings for hardware you don't have stay hidden.
The QuickLauncher opens from other apps and the app icon.
bugFixes: No automatic Shift in scripts without capitals, such as Thai.
Indicators are text symbols, never emoji.
Letters on the emoji layer and symbols pages type their mappings.
